spans.s: khuḍḍaka, adj., small (see s.v. khudrāka): SP 〔460.4〕 (prose; twice); v.l. Kashgar rec. for SP 〔95.5〕 (vs), text kuṇḍaka, q.v.
khuḍḍāka, adj., small (see s.v. khudrāka): Mv 〔i.302.13〕 na cāti- (mss. cāpi) khuḍḍākaṃ na cātimahantaṃ.
khuḍḍīka, cited as v.l. for kṣudrikā, kṣudrīka, q.v.
[khuḍḍulaka, adj., Kashgar rec. v.l. on SP 〔94.7〕, see s.v. vrāṇika; may contain a corruption of some form of khuḍḍa-(la?), see khuḍḍaka.]
